scopes.description: Full documented workflow from the run_all.py task registry, including preprocessing, supplied table programs, table2, and manuscript outputs. The producer-consumer order is traced; authorized routes for the required raw inputs remain unresolved.

requirements.description: The productivity, time-allocation, and balance-sheet preprocessing notebooks read the initial Company A internal/external and Company B/C pre-treatment CSVs; Company A internal/external weekly CSVs for weeks 1-2; Company B/C weekly CSVs for weeks 1-5; Company B/C week4/pre_treatment4.csv for the week-4 and week-5 joins; Company B/C post-treatment CSVs; and Company A internal pre_treatment_9_2.csv in processing_5. Source code names the paths and fields, but matching raw files and authorized routes are not established.

evidence.description: The datasheet identifies survey, field, and experiment data and gives collection periods.
evidence.quote:
Our data consist of three parts: the survey, field, and experiment data. The survey data were collected
through Prolific and Connect, two popular survey platforms in November 2024 and March 2025. The survey
methods and instruments are discussed in the paper and online appendix. The field data were obtained from
August 2024 to November 2024 and from March 2025 to April 2025. The experiment data were collected
from June 2025 to July 2025.

evidence.description: The field-data disclosure condition limits reporting to aggregate outcomes and does not itself state a data-access barrier.
evidence.quote:
The field data were obtained with a condition that the research team can only disclose the outcomes at the
aggregate-level without revealing any individual client information at the Partner Firm, which is
confidential.
